advertisers.title: Advertisers
advertisers.description: Who to look up. Each line can be an advertiser name (e.g. Nike; the best-matching advertiser with the most ads is used), an advertiser ID (AR followed by digits), a Transparency Center advertiser URL, or a website domain (e.g. nike.com: all ads pointing to that domain, from any advertiser).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Ads = the ads of each advertiser. Advertiser search = only look up names and return matching advertisers with their AR ID, country and ad count (no ads).

maxAdsPerAdvertiser.title: Max ads per advertiser
maxAdsPerAdvertiser.description: Stop after this many ads for each advertiser/domain. Newest ads come first. Each ad is one result.

region.title: Region (country where ads were shown)
region.description: 2-letter country code (US, GB, DE, IN, BR, ...). Leave empty for ads shown anywhere.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Only ads shown on this Google platform. Empty = all platforms.

dateFrom.title: Shown from
dateFrom.description: Only ads shown on or after this date: YYYY-MM-DD, or relative like "30 days". Empty = any time.

dateTo.title: Shown until
dateTo.description: Only ads shown on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today when Shown from is set.

includeAdContent.title: Include ad content (text, images, video)
includeAdContent.description: Download each ad's preview to extract headline, description, display URL, image URLs and YouTube video. Turn off for faster runs with only IDs, dates and formats.

maxAdvertisersPerQuery.title: Advertiser search: max results per name
maxAdvertisersPerQuery.description: Advertiser search mode: how many matching advertisers to return per name.

onlyNew.title: Only new items (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only ads (or, in advertiser search mode, advertisers) not returned by an earlier run with the same advertisers, region, formats and platform. Schedule the actor (e.g. daily) for new-ad alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new ads. Dates are not part of the key, so relative dates work. State is kept in the key-value store "google-ads-transparency-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed for most runs. By default the actor connects directly and, only if Google starts rate-limiting, switches to Apify's datacenter proxy (new IP on every block). Residential proxies are not required.
